page.content:
Empress and Justinian's political partner.

How Theodora connects

  • Character: Justinian I — Theodora was Justinian's empress and political partner.
  • Event: Nika riots — Theodora urged Justinian to stay during the Nika riots.

What is Theodora?

Theodora rose from the Hippodrome world to empress. During the Nika riots she is remembered for urging Justinian to hold the palace rather than flee.

Key threads lead to Justinian I and Nika riots.
